notes.title: “Perfect Partner” Demo up with New Content & Giveaway
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/a9af1223e77589919522b1124fc21e0d2637b408.png[/img]

"Perfect Partner" demo has been launched for everyone! You can now try it out and test your friendship with your partner by facing our challenging tasks and competing with other teams for the title of Perfect Partner.

[b]One-click to enter the challenge：[/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859270 

（Please add the game to your wishlist to follow up on future game updates.）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/fd05d6e236de396df2adc7cbc72fb12e5b253a5c.png[/img]

During your playtime, take 3 screenshots and upload them to the Steam community center under the 'Perfect Partner' category, followed by the artwork section. The artwork submission portal is: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1859270/images/. 
Once the final version of the game is launched, Little Peng will select 3 partners from the batch to receive the game's [b]official skin[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/fd05d6e236de396df2adc7cbc72fb12e5b253a5c.png[/img]

[b]Demo version update：[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/dfb2ace4e2ea84beeb27871317ce90a95712c9fb.png[/img]
1. Players can create their own rooms and play in it while waiting. 
2. Added local 2P and Controller support.
3. Optimized and adjusted the "Boating"，making the rhythm faster. 
4. Improved the experience of "Mahjong", added high-value cards. 
5. Optimized the experience of "Grabbing Peng".
6. Added new level "Dream Maze". 
7. Optimized the UI display and usage experience of room voice, added "Global Voice" and "Team Voice" switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867508/dd2d2844121e6bd01d5a0df258f5b4443358ee88.jpg[/img]
